description: This file defines the CacheInterface interface within the Psr\SimpleCache namespace, specifying contract methods for a cache system.

classes.name: CacheInterface
classes.description: Interface that defines the methods for a cache system, including get, set, delete, clear, and others.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a value from the cache by key, returning default if key not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an optional TTL.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an item from the cache by key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cache.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache items by their keys.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs in the cache with an optional TTL.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache items by their keys.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cache item exists for the given key.
